content:
maya: FYI staging canary just failed during prebake: quant build for kernel v3.2.1 checksum mismatch. Deploybot aborted canary.

deploybot: @channel deploy aborted: canary 2026-03-21T18:02Z - reason: checksum_mismatch - artifact: quant-kernel-v3.2.1.tar.gz :warning: 

sam: logs? where is the checksum calc from? quick snippet pls.

maya: tail from prebake logs below:
```
[2026-03-21T18:01:55Z] prebake: downloaded quant-kernel-v3.2.1.tar.gz
[2026-03-21T18:02:00Z] prebake: computed sha256: 3a7f...c2b1
[2026-03-21T18:02:01Z] prebake: expected sha256: 9f1d...7e8a
[2026-03-21T18:02:01Z] prebake: checksum_mismatch -> aborting
```

jules: ugh. we should pin back to v3.2.0 for staging + dedicated until we have a clean artifact. will that block the night cutover?

aditya: recommend pin for region-us + eu with TTL 6h so oncall can triage. also we should update the release notes and create a follow-up ticket for build infra.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-2345 "quant build checksum mismatch v3.2.1" assigned to @jules, due 2026-03-21 EOD.

maya: ok i'm going to pin now. command I ran:
```bash
./deploybot pin --artifact quant-kernel:v3.2.0 --scope staging,dedicated --regions us,eu --ttl 6h --reason "checksum mismatch v3.2.1 prebake"
```

deploybot: pinned quant-kernel:v3.2.0 in staging,dedicated (regions: us, eu) by maya. TTL 6h. :white_check_mark:

sam: quick confirm: canary aborted early so no traffic hit prod, right? metrics not impacted?

maya: canary traffic <100 rps, KV-cache warm not affected. no user-facing errors seen in canary window. we'll re-run prebake with debug flags + --strict-checksum to reproduce locally.

jules: i'll own followup investigation + packaging validation. will also draft the release-notes blurb: "Reverted kernel quant artifact to v3.2.0 due to checksum mismatch during prebake; investigation in progress. No user-facing impact." i'll send PR to release_notes repo.

aditya: please also ping support and product. product might want a one-line explainer for PMs.

maya: pinged #support and #product-notify with a short blurb.

sam: thanks. if this is packaging related we need to block any further v3.2.1 promotion.

maya: agreed. deploybot pin will effectively block promotion; i'll keep this thread updated. :ear:

maya: next steps: (1) jules to triage packaging + reproduce (INF-2345), (2) maya to re-run prebake with debug and attach checksums, (3) aditya to update release notes PR + notify PMs. reconvene in 2 hours or on new findings.
